agendas.name: Fulcrum of Fate
agendas.description: Select one Thread of Fate that has not been ended. Current stage effects apply during the battle. At battle end, if the Thread is ended successfully, select one non-destroyed AELDARI unit to gain 3XP. If not successful, advance to the next stage (or end in failure if Frayed).

agendas.name: Eldritch Supremacy
agendas.description: PSYKER units start with a tally of 0. Each time an enemy model is destroyed by a Psychic attack, +1 to that PSYKER's tally. At battle end: 3-5 tally = 1XP, 6-8 = 2XP, 9+ = 3XP per unit. Track tallies per PSYKER unit.

agendas.name: Few in Number
agendas.description: Select up to 3 AELDARI units before battle. At battle end, each selected unit that was not destroyed and destroyed 1+ enemy units gains 1XP (3XP if also not Below Half-strength).

agendas.name: Evasive Warfare
agendas.description: At battle end, for each battlefield corner with no enemy units within 12", select one non-Battle-shocked AELDARI unit wholly within 12" of that corner. XP is tiered by encircled corners: 2 corners = 1XP each, 3 = 2XP each, 4 = 3XP each. Track encircled corners as tallies per selected unit.
